component.name: NeoNote Media Player
component.summary: Music and video player inspired by Windows Media Player 12
Musik- und Videoplayer im Stil von Windows Media Player 12

description.p: NeoNote brings back the look and feel of Windows Media Player 12: a library organised by artist, album and genre, big album covers, a playlist on the right and a translucent “Now playing” view.

ul.li: Music library with artists, albums, genres, years, ratings and smart playlists
Videos with hardware decoding via mpv, subtitles, chapters and resume
Synced lyrics from .lrc files, embedded tags or LRCLIB
Gapless playback, equalizer, sleep timer and internet radio
Jellyfin server support, MPRIS media controls and a translucent window with blur on KDE Plasma

description.p: NeoNote bringt das Aussehen und Gefühl von Windows Media Player 12 zurück: eine Bibliothek nach Interpret, Album und Genre, große Cover, die Wiedergabeliste rechts und eine durchscheinende „Wird gespielt“-Ansicht.

Faster start with optional preloading at login, open music and videos with NeoNote like VLC, beta channel, safe mode with crash report, animated dialogs, what's new after updates, and updates for the Arch package.
Always on top, tooltips and menus in the glass look, more reliable update check and online features on fresh Windows installations.
Crossfade, playback speed, bit-perfect output, folder view, file organizer, scrobbling, artist info, visualization, Auto DJ and star ratings in the files.
Videos via mpv, lyrics, smart playlists, sleep timer and translucent dialogs.
